messages:
maria-support: FYI customer reports objects set to 30d retention still visible after 45d. Also when they tried to export audit logs we get 500: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED. Can ENG / INFRA help triage? Customer id: cust-8892. Example object id: obj_20260301_abc123. Repro steps below.

maria-support: CURL snippet for object metadata:
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_20260301_abc123\"
```
Response shows metadata: {"created_at":"2026-03-01T04:12:00Z","retention_days":30,"deletion_time":null} (object still searchable).

maria-support: Audit export call that failed:
```
POST /admin/audit/export HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
{"from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-03-15"}
```
Response: 500 {"error":"KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED","message":"unable to decrypt audit key"} (request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d).

jamie-eng: adding @eng-infra and @eng-security. Can you paste the full request-id and the x-request-id header from the failed export? Which region is the customer in and are they using CMK?

maria-support: request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d, x-request-id: xreq-77d2, region: eu-west-1, customer uses customer-managed KMS (arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd).

audit-export-bot: Automated note: export job rq_0a1b2c3d - status FAILED - error KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED - timestamp 2026-03-16T10:19:12Z.

paul-infra: I see matching errors in the KMS proxy logs. There was a key rotation event for that CMK on 2026-02-28 and a handful of transient decrypt/encrypt failures were observed. Looks like the TTL/tombstone worker attempted to write encrypted tombstone metadata and hit encrypt failures; it reached retry limit and dropped the job. Requeue didn't occur.

nina-privacy: urgent question — did the customer set a legal_hold or litigation flag on this dataset? If so we must not delete. maria, can you confirm with the customer before we run any purge?

maria-support: Customer confirms they did NOT request a legal hold. They checked the dataset UI and see default retention 30d; they also said they created a custom override but UI shows 30d as well. They are adamant objects older than 30d are still searchable.

jamie-eng: Proposed repro/triage plan:
1) check tombstone queue for obj_20260301_abc123 and similar ids.
2) run one-off tombstone reprocess: POST /admin/internal/reprocess-tombstone?obj=obj_20260301_abc123 (this will re-encrypt metadata and write tombstone).
3) if reprocess fails due to CMK decrypt/encrypt, fetch KMS proxy logs and escalate to security/infra for CMK rotation handling.
4) re-run audit export after tombstone is written.

paul-infra: Kicking off reprocess now. Logs show: WARN KMS_ENCRYPT_FAIL for metadata write at 2026-03-16T10:21:03Z, retry limit reached. Starting manual re-encrypt attempt with fallback key. If successful we'll mark object tombstoned and run purge. If not, we will coordinate immediate CMK rollback/patch.

alex-legal: Please preserve current audit export artifacts. Do NOT purge any deleted markers until legal confirms. We may need preserved evidence for discovery.

maria-support: Customer is asking for ETA — any estimate for manual remediation?

paul-infra: ETA: manual re-encrypt + tombstone + purge for this customer ~ 6 hours (running now). Root fix (increase TTL worker retry + CMK rotation detection) targeted for staging tomorrow and prod patch next week. I will post job logs here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamie-eng: I opened RL-4392 to track retry/backoff improvement and a detector for CMK rotation side-effects. Tagging @nina-privacy for compliance review of the fix.

maria-support: thanks all — I'll update the customer with the ETA and preserve the export artifacts. Will post back when manual job completes. :thumbsup:
